title: Arkansas Guardsmen Conduct Damage Assessment in Texas Town, Hurricane Harvey
description:
Soldiers of the Arkansas National Guard, members of Task Force Aleutian, conducted damage assessments in the vicinity of Lumberton, Tex, just outside of Beaumont.

The Damage Assessment Teams were sent out to analyze and estimate the extent of the damages caused by Hurricane Harvey. 

(U.S. Army National Guard video by Spc. Stephen M. Wright)

transcript.text: - [Stephen] Soldiers of the Arkansas National Guard,
members of Task Force Solutions,
conducted damage assessments
in the vicinity of Lumberton, Texas,
not too far from the the city of Beaumont.
The damage assessment teams were sent out
to analyze and estimate the extent of the damages
caused by Hurricane Harvey.
Walking or driving, every single house in their sector
was given an approximate rating of the damage.
- [Man] Eight, zero, zero, eight.
- [Stephen] The Arkansas Guardsmen
also offered MREs or water to the citizens
that they encountered along their way,
even assisting citizens
by helping to move large pieces of debris.
A somber sight for most,
but some found joy in the companionship
and helpfulness of these Arkansas Guardsmen.
For the Arkansas National Guard in Beaumont, Texas,
I'm Specialist Stephen Wright.
